|notes=* The Used or Lost Interrupt type bar is printed on this partial. Title, side, uniqueness, destiny and lore follow the full Players Committee face ([[:File:V9-L-rescueintheclouds.gif]]); those upper fields are omitted. Rarity follows the underlying [[Rescue In The Clouds]] printing.
* '''Later official partial''' ([[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata 4)]]): the October 2023 Set 9 edition prints E1 and changes the frame and game-text wrapping from the earlier unnumbered-E paper layout. The complete archived Set 9 sheet known by 5 October 2021 repeats that earlier paper design; it is not an additional image version.<ref>[[:File:Errata-Sheet-2021-Spring-original.pdf|Official Errata Sheet 2021 Spring]], page 2, and [[:File:Virtual-Set-9-October-2023.pdf|Official Set 9 sheet, October 2023 edition]], page 6.</ref> [[File:V9-L-rescueintheclouds-2021-2023-partial-layout-difference.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and later official partial layouts.]]
* The Spring 2021 sheet identifies its text edition as 19 March 2021; its PDF build timestamp does not establish publication. The earlier full-face PNG was committed [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2f0f28b5b6fa47e28f68524abf93bcb326a93280 2021-03-18T18:35:11Z]. A [https://www.starwarsccg.org/14-burning-questions-for-v-set-14/ PC article dated 20 March 2021] links that Spring sheet. The exact first paper-publication day and its ordering against the March full-face copy are not established by those facts; the existing 2021 article labels are retained here.
* The current full-face [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/hires/rescueintheclouds.png PNG] was authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z; the complete RGB pixels and dimensions match the later GIF copy committed 19:39:59Z that UTC day. These are one image state.
